payload.comment:
Both issues from the previous review are properly resolved in the revised narrative. (1) The architecture misidentification in `best_configuration.representation.rationale` is now explicitly flagged in §1 with a clear explanation that the selected model is ResNet18 per the bundle manifest and program source, while the persisted rationale text contains a transformer-specific justification that is architecture-mismatched. (2) The lymphocyte false-positive count is corrected to 28 with the per-source breakdown (5+2+21), consistent with the confusion matrix column sum (662 total predictions, 634 TP, 28 FP; precision 634/662=0.957704 ✓).

All core metrics re-verified: accuracy 6590/7180=0.917827 ✓; OOD aggregate (0.934119+0.937481+0.958463)/3=0.943354 ✓; selective-prediction coverage/risk internally consistent (abstain_rate 0.307242, human_review_count 2206, accuracy_on_covered 0.975875) ✓; data audit all-pass with zero overlap ✓; search stopping rationale is a process constraint (no resumable candidates), not a performance-ceiling claim ✓. The narrative correctly identifies inactive transformer fields for the CNN family and documents the separate-center test provenance without asserting unsupported causal mechanisms. No clinical claims are made. The report is substantively accurate and complete.
observations: Minor descriptive inaccuracy in §1 table: depth=2 is labeled 'Residual block depth multiplier,' but per the fixed ResNet18 topology, depth is ignored (only hidden controls base width). The parameter is correctly identified as being passed to build_network and the overall architecture identification is accurate; this is a table-cell wording issue with no effect on computed results.

The 7.8-point validation-to-test gap (99.59%→91.78%) is documented with the separate-center provenance (official_test_separate_center: true) without asserting a specific causal mechanism. This is the most ecologically valid distribution-shift signal in the report.

OOD evaluation is scoped as a controlled corruption proxy (additive Gaussian noise, σ∈{0.15,0.25,0.40}). It validates pixel-level noise detection but does not capture staining variability, scanner differences, or tissue-preparation artifacts.

Selective-prediction coverage gap: validation achieves 80.0% coverage at target, test achieves 69.3% (abstain rate 30.7%, 2,206 samples to human review). This is a calibration-transfer effect between validation and test entropy distributions.
All results use a single seed (42); cross-seed variance is not characterized.

The two weakest test classes (cancer-associated stroma F1=0.667, smooth muscle F1=0.768) are histologically similar spindle-cell/fibrous tissues and are also among the smallest classes (421 and 592 samples).
Search evaluated 8 trials (5 transformer, 3 ResNet18) via run_generated. Stopping is a process constraint (no resumable candidates), not a performance-ceiling inference from two similar trials.
